_about: A350-1000, from Airbus AC A350 (Jul 01/26) 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A350-1000 sheets 1 (side, front: page index 51) and 2 (plan: page index 52). Shaded pictures: layers.py --mode lines, line centres. The A350-900's points moved by the plugs (the wing by +3.82 m) onto these sheets and snapped (a35k/*.anchors.json). Scaled by the drawn doors 1, 2 and 4 against the door-location figure (2-7-0, page index 111), 40.36 px a meter: the nose then falls on the sheet's nose and the printed 72.25 m on its tail cone. Door 3 (over the wing) is placed from that figure (42.38 m); the windows behind the wing's lines at the drawing's pitch. The cockpit panes are the A350-900's (the same nose), which land on this sheet's.

sources.title: Airbus, A350 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (Jul 01/26), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions (A350-1000, sheets 1-2); 2-7-0 Door Location
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/a35k/), starting from the A350-900's points moved by the fuselage plugs; the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. Shaded picture sheets of about 40 pixels a meter: outlines good to about 3 cm. Door 3, over the wing, is placed from the door-location figure; the windows behind the wing's lines at the drawing's pitch; the cockpit panes are the A350-900's. As on the A350-900's sheet, the plan draws the tailplane about 3% wider than its printed 18.79 m span (the front view agrees with the print); the shape keeps the plan's.
